title: Baidyanath — Depth & Specificity Research
content:
Baidyanath is India's most trusted brand for Ayurvedic treatment, producing a wide range of Ayurvedic products including Ayurvedic Tablets, Ayurvedic Syrups and Ark, Ayurvedic Capsules, Ayurvedic Chyawanprash, Medicated Oils and Ghritas, Herbal Juices and Tonics, Bhasma and Pishti Preparations, Asava and Aristhas, Churans, Gold Medicines, and Food and Nutrition Supplements. The company has launched notable marketing initiatives such as the "Sahi Vidhi, Behtar Immunity" campaign for Baidyanath Chyawanprash during the COVID-19 pandemic. Baidyanath ensures that their products deliver the goodness of Ayurveda and are sold at over 1,00,000 retail outlets.

Baidyanath differentiates itself in the FMCG & Consumer Goods sector by emphasizing its heritage and traditional Ayurvedic formulations. It focuses on ingredient count and procedural fidelity ("Sahi Vidhi") rather than modern reformulation or price competition. The company highlights specific, falsifiable claims related to its classical texts, production tools, and ingredient figures, setting it apart from larger competitors like Dabur. Baidyanath's extensive product range includes over 700 Ayurvedic formulations sold at more than 100,000 retail outlets, showcasing its commitment to delivering authentic Ayurveda.
